# Rename rewrite can fail to preserve symbol-level anchors

_symbol_path rewriting on renames only occurs when the old module prefix matches the anchor's symbol_path. If that condition is not met, symbol_path is not rewritten and symbol-level anchor overlap may evaluate to zero across renames, causing missed matches.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.normalize._map_anchor`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.normalize._file_to_module`
